# Run Yang--Mills Clay Programme

## Mission

Coordinate the complete theorem chain without letting conceptual reformulation substitute for the missing analytic estimates. Default to a regulator-agnostic atlas; prior Wilson-action work is optional and used only for a necessary comparison or calibration.

## Phase Order

1. Use `ym-freeze-clay-target` to state the exact existence-and-gap target and claim hierarchy.
2. Use `ym-build-observable-core` to freeze the physical observable algebra and density obligations.
3. Use `ym-build-representation-calculus` to type representations, morphisms, certificates, and error budgets.
4. Use `ym-design-regulator-atlas` to select or compare regulator families.
5. Use `ym-define-relational-rigidity` and falsify it on the counterexample bank.
6. Use `ym-prove-rigidity-transfer` to prove the conditional spectral bridge.
7. Use `ym-build-gauge-covariant-rg` and `ym-control-large-fields-and-topology` to construct the multiscale engine.
8. Use `ym-design-infrared-basin` and `ym-prove-rg-to-rigidity` to isolate a noncircular sufficient mechanism.
9. Use `ym-prove-basin-entry` to attack the central four-dimensional frontier theorem.
10. Use `ym-prove-continuum-coherence` and `ym-reconstruct-os-gap` to construct and interpret the continuum theory.
11. Use `ym-calibrate-restricted-models` and `ym-mechanize-proof-core` throughout, not only at the end.
12. Use `ym-audit-frontier` before raising any claim level.

## Persistent Ledgers

Maintain a theorem dependency graph, parameter registry, limit-order ledger, representation certificate table, observable-completeness ledger, counterexample bank, evidence ledger, and claim-status table. Each claim is `proved`, `imported`, `conditional`, `failed`, or `open`.

## Phase Gates

Do not advance a claim past a failed gate. Positivity, physical-unit uniformity, full-measure control, observable density, theory identity, continuum convergence, or regulator independence cannot be repaired by rhetoric downstream. Continue by proving a restricted theorem or identifying the first missing inequality.

## Final Output

Produce a self-contained paper or dossier with definitions, proved and conditional theorems, counterexamples, executable artifacts, primary-source comparisons, and an explicit frontier statement. Claim `C6` only when every link of the Clay target is closed for every compact simple gauge group; otherwise state the strongest lower level precisely.
